shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up at a low angle: a young woman pushes open a heavy carved wooden door of an old mansion on a rainy night and steps into the foyer, her face filling the frame, backlit by the glowing rain curtain behind her, water droplets dripping from her hair. Cool steel-blue moonlight from the storm outside rims her silhouette and the thousands of backlit rain streaks; a warm dim amber foyer lamp wraps one side of her cheek; the old door's wet walnut wood grain glistens; thin mist drifts through the backlight beam.
